title: The empty chart outline is a grey dashed box with a chart icon
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  1. User: you are signed in as a user whose role has the Reports permission (for example Admin).
  2. Browser: you use a desktop browser window at least 1024 pixels wide (a maximised laptop or desktop window).
  3. Location: you are in a location (workplace) with nothing in it: no work order, invoice, credit or clocked time (for example ZZAUTOTEST Empty Shop).
custom_steps:
1. Click Dashboard in the top menu with ZZAUTOTEST Empty Shop selected.
  2. Look closely at the empty-chart outline on the Billing Efficiency tile.
  3. Switch the app to the dark theme (if the build offers a theme switch in the user menu at the top right) and look again.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: The outline is a light grey dashed line with rounded corners.
  • Steps 2 and 3: The inside of the outline has no fill: the tile's own background shows through it (white in light theme, the dark tile colour in dark theme).
  • Step 2: A grey line-chart icon sits at the centre of the outline.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9576 (Story 4, KPI Hero Tiles); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850 v48, read 14 Oct 2026, Story 4. Design canvas (claude.ai/artifact/Wae9DFQ8PJQBy8mbLsL5ge, as re-shared and read 14 Oct 2026; a screenshot of the SV-490 build re-shot on 14 Oct 2026) board 15_Empty_After (row 15).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-R15: “The placeholder is an outline drawn as a light grey dashed line, with rounded corners and no fill. The tile's background shows through it.”
  • S4-R16: “A line-chart icon, in grey, sits at the center of the placeholder.”

Last checked against build v26.40.8-754bd3a on 10/13/2026.
